feature: Opt-in stopped bounded regional measured-map relocalization
scope: Authored fixed routes, surveyed map, ordinary synchronous body-XY LiDAR. No global initialization, mission-state recovery, automotive qualification or real-time guarantee.
platform: Linux x86_64; configured other CI platforms not locally observed

design.feature: Opt-in bounded regional fixed-map relocalization after motion loss
design.scope: Fixed routes with supplied surveyed map and ordinary synchronous XY LiDAR. Exclude navigation, lane changes, mapped signals/signs/intersections and XYZ/multi-height inputs. Existing default remains latched.

search.hypotheses: Five yaw angles; complete raw scan/map pair translation voting, top25 cells per angle; at most125 ICP seeds
search.scan_subset: Fixed evenly distributed indices i*N/min(N,128), selected before scoring; original raw scan retained
search.refinement_index: Exact balanced k-d tree; visit nearer half-space first, prune farther only beyond current Euclidean bound, retain equal-distance index ties; each visited point charges shared budget. Ordinary local registration retains old grid.

design.epoch: Fresh measured pose/covariance initializes new filter, histories, tracks, occupancy/planning/control. Preserve route/config calibration; increment localization epoch. Pre-reset GNSS/LiDAR acquisitions cannot renew freshness; the confirming frame brakes.
design.scoring: All global CLI accuracy failures and invalid-epoch errors remain. Qualify valid epochs separately plus physical stop/recovered goal. No truth or true pose enters driver recovery.
design.retention: Freeze all28 inputs and all sources before physical execution; keep every first outcome. All470 prior recordings and245 standard outputs must retain exact replay bytes.

development_history.initial_grid_rejected: Two synthetic unit tests showed missed displaced solutions and missed periodic alternatives. Failed logs and development-grid-regional.rs retained. Repaired with correlation-generated hypotheses before physical qualification.

first_algorithm_revision_A.explanation: All12 recovery cases exhausted the20-million comparison cap and stayed stopped. Exact k-d tree neighbors repaired search work in revision B; all28 identical frozen cases were rerun, with unchanged gates, budget and hypotheses.

auditor_repair.reason: The original checker imposed a small extra unexecuted fixed-point step, while the predeclared existing ICP criterion stops on the last executed translation/yaw increments. The final checker reconstructs all actual bounded ICP steps from each best/witness raw selected seed, verifies the published pose, and independently verifies raw residual/covariance. No tolerance is raised.
